content:
iPhone Duo is launching later this month, but Apple reportedly has many other new products set to debut in October too, with the first unveilings coming next week. Here’s what to expect.

Apple Home product upgrades with Siri AI

Apple’s long-awaited overhaul and expansion of its Home products lineup is reportedly coming next week on Tuesday, October 13.

Apple Home upgrades are expected to center around Siri AI and other Apple Intelligence features that are exclusive to new hardware. Here’s what’s rumored:

  • New Apple TV 4K: A19 or A19 Pro chip, Siri AI, new Siri Remote
  • HomePad: Home hub with built-in touchscreen
  • HomePod mini 2: More powerful chip, audio upgrades, more

New Macs, including high-end MacBook Pro redesign with touchscreen

It’s been a big year for the Mac already, with MacBook Neo, the M5 MacBook Air, and high-end M5 MacBook Pros launching in the spring, followed by the recent Mac mini and Mac Studio debuts.

But Apple has more new models coming, including its first ever touchscreen MacBook. Three rumored Macs include:

  • New MacBook Pro/Ultra: All-new design for high-end MacBook with touch, OLED, more
  • M6 MacBook Pro: Update for 14-inch base MacBook Pro
  • M6 iMac: Powerful chip and new color options

iPhone Duo and new iPad mini

iPhone Duo arrives in users’ hands this month. Pre-orders open October 16 ahead of the first deliveries October 23. And per Bloomberg, an upgraded iPad mini could launch around the same time too.

  • iPhone Duo: Apple’s first ever foldable iPhone
  • New iPad mini: OLED display, A20 Pro chip, thinner bezels

Which Apple products for October are you most interested in? Let us know in the comments.
